data.body: Fix implemented and pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1044 (change 1044, commit f822315). Root cause: the 228b DET-floor short-circuit (c781127a2) blocks a DET-failing plan with zero finder calls, so test_plan_review_reuse's fixture (a plan with no AC checklist, DET-blocked by design) stopped exercising the LLM tier — test_force_bypasses_verdict_reuse and test_code_change_reruns_full_review failed on 'calls > first_calls' (0 > 0). Fix (tests only): the fixture plan now passes the DET floor (proper '## Acceptance Criteria' checklist) and the counting fake manufactures the BLOCK from the LLM tier — an F1 finding (blocking posture, threshold 0.60) verified full-yes at high severity, so Pass-3 decides 'block'. All 7 tests in the file keep their original semantics; audited the whole file for the same latent assumption (the two render tests use literal dicts, unaffected). Gates: file + tests/unit/workflow/test_det_short_circuit.py green, make lint + make typecheck clean. Awaiting LLM-Review/Verified.
